sections.title: We Will Rise Again
paragraphs: Palestinian Sabbah graduated from Selcuk University, Faculty of Communication, Department of Journalism, in 2021 as the top student in the department and the third in the faculty. Palestinian Animation and Graphic Artist Abrar Sabbah has redrawn the cartoon targeting Türkiye, published by the French magazine Charlie Hebdo after the earthquake. In the video she published on her social media account, Sabbah redesigns the cartoon published by the weekly humor magazine Charlie Hebdo about the earthquake disaster in Türkiye, and says, "Hey, immoral Charlie Hebdo. You shouldn’t have drawn it like that. You should have drawn it like this! We will rise again. This strong nation will rise again!"
